Title: Customer-Managed Keys (preview) integration with Azure Chaos Studio

Body.Content:
Azure Chaos Studio now supports running Experiments encrypted using your own (Customer Managed) encryption keys. This feature is in preview and is supported on all Chaos Studio experiments via our REST API and preview SDKs only. Run your Chaos Experiments and have fine-grained control over key-rotation policies using CMK for Chaos Studio. Available using the 2023-10-27-preview REST API.  

For more information about Azure Chaos Studio, see Azure Chaos Studio documentation.
